project.subject: Lakkan corporate website motion refinement
project.audience: Business leaders evaluating practical AI implementation and prospective collaborators
project.singleJob: Make Lakkan feel visibly alive and premium while keeping its public corporate story immediately understandable

layout.summary: A fixed-width editorial canvas sits inside full-bleed color fields; large copy occupies the upper left while horizontally clipped cards create depth below.
evidence: At 1440px the primary content is 1104px wide at x=168.
The first card rail begins at y=493 and deliberately exposes off-canvas cards.

spacing.summary: Generous vertical staging separates the headline, supporting copy, category rail, and visual cards; spacing is rhythmic rather than uniformly dense.
evidence: Desktop H1 starts at y=145 and category navigation at y=426.
Major sections range from 423px to 1540px high, giving motion room to resolve.

typography.summary: Large restrained sans-serif headlines are punctuated by one expressive serif word; line height stays tight and body copy remains compact.
evidence: Mobile H1 is 40/42.4px within 342px at x=24.

color.summary: A near-black base is activated by a single electric blue and a broad diffused blue glow; color indicates focus rather than decorating every element.
evidence: One accent word, active category, CTA, and ambient glow share the same blue family.
Inactive text and borders use low-contrast neutrals.

imagery.summary: Product previews act as the imagery; they are large, cropped, and presented as moving editorial specimens instead of decorative photography.
evidence: Desktop preview cards are approximately 400px wide.
Mobile retains oversized clipped cards instead of shrinking them into thumbnails.

motion.summary: Motion is staged: a 1s hero entrance, a slow 10s ambient glow, and a continuously translating card rail of roughly 55px/s. The interface changes focus without moving the entire page at once.
evidence: Computed animation names include lp-hero-in (1s), lp-glow-enter (1.6s), and lp-glow-pulse (10s).
The card rail transform changed from -1777.63px to -1711.08px over 1.2s.

components.summary: The page is built from sticky navigation, oversized editorial headings, compact category controls, and clipped preview rails with one active state.
evidence: Category controls are 32px high while visual cards dominate the hierarchy.

responsive.summary: Mobile preserves the same motion composition using 24px gutters and horizontal clipping, while navigation simplifies and documents remain overflow-safe.
evidence: At 390px the document width equals client width: 390px.
H1 and section type scale down but the card rail remains visually oversized.

contract.hero: Keep Lakkan's three-panel 300vh horizontal hero, replace always-running per-character magnetism with a masked two-line entrance, and add a precise three-step scroll-progress rail.
contract.grid: Maximum 1280px Lakkan editorial grid; capability stage uses one clipped 300% horizontal track with three full-width scenes.
contract.imageryMode: No copied 21st assets. Use Lakkan typography, CSS blueprint diagrams, public work counts, and existing public components only.
contract.signatureInteraction: Scroll through Define, Build, and Run as a pinned three-scene capability rail; active label and progress line remain synchronized.
forbiddenGenericPatterns: generic three-card grid as the main capability interaction

visualReview.referenceDeltaSummary: Transferred the reference's staged entrance, synchronized active controls, clipped horizontal scene rail, and scroll-led pacing. Retained Lakkan's light tracing-paper palette, Japanese editorial type, proof-mark colors, original copy, and original public assets; no 21st theme or component imagery was copied.
